title: 軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析
summary: 本課聚焦以土水作用、支護壓力梯度與失土證據界定軟土開挖面模型。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on bound soft-ground face models using soil-water interaction, pressure gradients and ground-loss evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「總應力與有效應力」與「壓力梯度與高度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Total and effective stress" and "Pressure gradient with height": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 總應力與有效應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Total and effective stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「總應力與有效應力」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Total and effective stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軟土開挖面受骨架應力與孔隙水共同作用，短期不排水黏土和排水砂土需要不同強度描述。把土水壓力合併成單一數值再任意扣減，容易重複計入或遺漏孔壓。 假設總法向應力300 kPa、孔壓180 kPa，有效應力120 kPa；這只是應力分解，不是支護壓力設定。 將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「總應力與有效應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Face loading combines skeleton stress and pore water. Short-term undrained clay and drained sand require different strength descriptions; merging everything into one pressure and then subtracting arbitrarily can double-count or omit water effects. Assumed total normal stress 300 kPa and pore pressure 180 kPa give effective stress 120 kPa; this is decomposition, not a support-pressure setting. Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Total and effective stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不排水強度和排水摩擦角可不分條件地混在同一模型。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Undrained strength and drained friction can be mixed unconditionally in one model." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「總應力與有效應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Total and effective stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 總應力與有效應力
knowledge.text: 軟土開挖面受骨架應力與孔隙水共同作用，短期不排水黏土和排水砂土需要不同強度描述。把土水壓力合併成單一數值再任意扣減，容易重複計入或遺漏孔壓。
knowledge.textEn: Face loading combines skeleton stress and pore water. Short-term undrained clay and drained sand require different strength descriptions; merging everything into one pressure and then subtracting arbitrarily can double-count or omit water effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：不排水強度和排水摩擦角可不分條件地混在同一模型。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Undrained strength and drained friction can be mixed unconditionally in one model. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析」的「總應力與有效應力：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「隧道模型掘進交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Total and effective stress: mechanism and system paths” in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tunnel model drive handover” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「總應力與有效應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Total and effective stress" is correct?
options: 不排水強度和排水摩擦角可不分條件地混在同一模型。
軟土開挖面受骨架應力與孔隙水共同作用，短期不排水黏土和排水砂土需要不同強度描述。
一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。
optionsEn: Undrained strength and drained friction can be mixed unconditionally in one model.
Face loading combines skeleton stress and pore water.
A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face.
quiz.explanation: 軟土開挖面受骨架應力與孔隙水共同作用，短期不排水黏土和排水砂土需要不同強度描述。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Face loading combines skeleton stress and pore water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 總應力與有效應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Total and effective stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「總應力與有效應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Total and effective stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總法向應力300 kPa、孔壓180 kPa，有效應力120 kPa；這只是應力分解，不是支護壓力設定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed total normal stress 300 kPa and pore pressure 180 kPa give effective stress 120 kPa; this is decomposition, not a support-pressure setting. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總法向應力300 kPa、孔壓180 kPa，有效應力120 kPa；這只是應力分解，不是支護壓力設定。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed total normal stress 300 kPa and pore pressure 180 kPa give effective stress 120 kPa; this is decomposition, not a support-pressure setting.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「總應力與有效應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Total and effective stress", which statement holds?
options: 某工程的臨界穩定指標可以不看幾何直接搬到另一工程。
濕出土重量增加就必定代表原位土被過量開挖。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: A critical stability index transfers between projects without considering geometry.
Greater wet discharge mass necessarily means excessive excavation of in-situ soil.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 總應力與有效應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Total and effective stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「總應力與有效應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Total and effective stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄總應力與有效應力的資料來源與適用條件。以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for total and effective stress. Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄總應力與有效應力的資料來源與適用條件。以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for total and effective stress. Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range.

quiz.question: 要驗證「總應力與有效應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Total and effective stress"?
options: 以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
高透水砂只占小面積，就一定只造成同等比例風險。
optionsEn: Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A small permeable sand area necessarily contributes only that proportional share of risk.
quiz.explanation: 以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 總應力與有效應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Total and effective stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「總應力與有效應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Total and effective stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不排水強度和排水摩擦角可不分條件地混在同一模型。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Undrained strength and drained friction can be mixed unconditionally in one model." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「總應力與有效應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Total and effective stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。
一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency.
A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face.
quiz.explanation: 將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓力梯度與高度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure gradient with height: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力梯度與高度」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure gradient with height” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 倉內支護介質有自重，頂部與底部壓力不同，而地層與水壓梯度也未必相同。只控制單一感測器讀值不能保證全掌子面均衡，必須把所有讀值換算到共同高度再比較分布。 假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。 以底部壓力代表頂部會高估頂拱支護，密度分層又使線性換算失準；局部失穩可能在平均壓力看似正常時開始，不能只盯總平均。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力梯度與高度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Support medium has weight, creating different crown and invert pressures, while soil and groundwater gradients may differ. One sensor does not prove full-face balance; readings need a common elevation and a distribution comparison. For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range. Using invert pressure for the crown overstates crown support, while density stratification invalidates a linear conversion. Local instability can begin with a normal-looking mean pressure, making averages insufficient. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure gradient with height” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力梯度與高度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力梯度與高度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure gradient with height" is correct?

支護壓力越高越安全，不必考慮淺覆土上舉。
倉內支護介質有自重，頂部與底部壓力不同，而地層與水壓梯度也未必相同。
optionsEn: A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face.
Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift.
Support medium has weight, creating different crown and invert pressures, while soil and groundwater gradients may differ.
quiz.explanation: 倉內支護介質有自重，頂部與底部壓力不同，而地層與水壓梯度也未必相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 壓力梯度與高度：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力梯度與高度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure gradient with height” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對壓力計高程、零點與介質密度，將多高度讀值畫成梯度並對照理論；若梯度異常需查分層、氣泡或堵塞，經設計及設備主管評估後才可解讀成地層壓力變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check sensor elevation, zero and medium density, plotting multiheight readings against the expected gradient; investigate segregation, air or blockage before design and equipment leads interpret an anomaly as changing ground pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure gradient with height” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對壓力計高程、零點與介質密度，將多高度讀值畫成梯度並對照理論；若梯度異常需查分層、氣泡或堵塞，經設計及設備主管評估後才可解讀成地層壓力變化。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：以底部壓力代表頂部會高估頂拱支護，密度分層又使線性換算失準；局部失穩可能在平均壓力看似正常時開始，不能只盯總平均。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check sensor elevation, zero and medium density, plotting multiheight readings against the expected gradient; investigate segregation, air or blockage before design and equipment leads interpret an anomaly as changing ground pressure. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using invert pressure for the crown overstates crown support, while density stratification invalidates a linear conversion. Local instability can begin with a normal-looking mean pressure, making averages insufficient. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for pressure gradient with height. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
